name: Scotland
oneLineFragment: Heather-cloaked glens and rain-scoured granite lochs.
narrativeStory:
Peat smoke drifting from remote stone crofts as evening falls over Glen Coe. The clouds cling to the razor ridges of the Cuillin, dropping sheets of cold rain that scent the air with heather and bog myrtle.

Here the geology is dramatic and brooding, worn smooth by ancient glaciers and centuries of Atlantic squalls.
subtitle: Isle of Skye & The Western Highlands
introLines: Heather moors under low maritime rain.
Loch water cold as slate reflecting ancient pines.
Eight frames recorded through shifting Atlantic squalls.
